product.name: Velara CoolPad 2025
product.description: Velara CoolPad 2025 is a lightweight, ergonomically designed cooling pad for laptops ranging from 13 to 15 inches. The aluminum alloy base provides excellent heat dissipation, while the silicone rubber pads reduce vibration and noise. A single 5‑W fan, powered via a USB‑C Power Delivery 45W port, maintains a steady airflow without drawing excessive power. The compact 25‑cm width and 3‑cm thickness make it portable for travel and office use. The midnight black finish blends with modern laptop aesthetics, and the pad includes a detachable cable for easy storage. It is compatible with most USB‑C laptops and offers a silent cooling experience for extended work sessions.
